Description of Incident: Major uncontrolled blowout occurred during workover operations to test a deeper gas reservoir. The blow-out preventer (BOP) stack failed to seal around the workstring when high pressure gas surged from the producing sand. Secondary blowout prevention measures were compromised. Gas plume ignited into a major fire lasting several weeks. Two fire personnel sustained fatal injuries during emergency containment attempts.
Hazard Type: High Pressure Inflammable Natural Gas & Condensate
Barrier Failure: BOP Annular and Blind Ram sealing failure / Loss of primary hydrostatic well control barrier
Consequence: Uncontrolled Well Blowout, Explosion, Fire, and Two Fatalities
OISD Standard: OISD-GDN-206 Safety in Drilling & Well Servicing Operations

Activity Underway: High Pressure Gas Manifold Valve Servicing
Description of Incident: During scheduled maintenance on gas manifold valve MV-102, crew removed bonnet studs while residual pressure of 48 kg/cm2 was trapped between the primary ball valve and check valve. High pressure gas escaping through the loosened bonnet ejected the valve assembly in the line of fire. One technician sustained fracture to right forearm. JSA had not specified physical line bleeding before unbolting.
Hazard Type: Compressed Natural Gas under High Pressure
Barrier Failure: Failure to depressurize and verify zero energy before breaking containment
Consequence: Component Projectile Ejection, Loss of Containment, Severe Arm Fracture
OISD Standard: OISD-STD-105 Work Permit System & Positive Isolation

Installation / Unit: Digboi Refinery Area - Crude Distillation Unit (CDU-II)
Activity Underway: Hot Work Welding on Platform Handrail near Desalter
Description of Incident: Contract welders commenced structural grinding and tack welding on a mezzanine grating near the crude desalter vessel without checking local hydrocarbon drain sumps. Combustible gas detector had not been calibrated that morning. Sparks from grinding landed into an oily sewer opening containing volatile light naphtha vapors, igniting a flash fire. Two workers suffered 2nd-degree burn injuries.
Barrier Failure: Absence of sewer covers and failure to perform mandatory continuous hot-work gas monitoring
Consequence: Flash Fire in Process Unit, Burn Injuries

Description of Incident: During hydrotest pressure buildup to 150 kg/cm2, a temporary test blind flange parted catastrophically due to incorrect grade bolts (commercial carbon steel used instead of alloy B7 studs). High pressure water and air jet whipped the test hose across the walkway. No workers were present in the designated barricaded exclusion zone. Zero injuries; test pump tripped immediately.
Barrier Failure: Use of substandard fasteners / failure of QA inspection on test manifold blinds
Consequence: Equipment Damage, High Pressure Hose Whipping, Potential SIF Near Miss
OISD Standard: OISD-STD-137 Inspection of Chemical Plant Equipment

Description of Incident: Overhead gantry crane was used to lift a 1.2 metric ton compressor cylinder head. The synthetic webbing sling was rigged over sharp unpadded cast-iron corners. Under load, the sling sheared through, dropping the cylinder head 1.8 meters onto the concrete maintenance bay deck. Two workers were standing 2 meters away outside the drop radius. Tag lines were not utilized.
Energy Source: Gravitational Potential Energy (1.2 MT at 1.8m height)
Barrier Failure: Failure to utilize sling corner softeners and failure to establish clear crane exclusion perimeter
Consequence: Dropped Object, Concrete Floor Gouge, Near Miss SIF
OISD Standard: OISD-STD-114 Hazardous Area Classification and Rigging

Description of Incident: Technician reached beneath active chain conveyor to dislodge an empty 14.2 kg LPG cylinder without locking out electrical drive motor breaker. Co-worker pressed conveyor reset push-button from the opposite control console. Technician glove became entangled in sprocket teeth, resulting in partial amputation of right index fingertip.
Barrier Failure: Failure to implement Lockout / Tagout (LOTO) and defeat of conveyor nip-point guarding
OISD Standard: OISD-STD-144 Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Bottling Plants
